name: Bryan Guiney
occupation: Oregon Field Office Director, US Department of Housing and Urban Development

bio.statement: Guiney's pamphlet statement lists service as a U.S. Marine Corps infantry officer and Business Oregon development officer.
bio.excerpt: Infantry Officer, US Marine Corps; Development Officer, Business Oregon;

bio.statement: Guiney's pamphlet statement lists a BA from the University of Oregon and an MBA from the University of Washington.
bio.excerpt: University of Oregon, BA (2006); University of Washington, MBA (2017)

bio.statement: Guiney's pamphlet statement lists service on the Lake Oswego Planning Commission and the Eagle Creek Wildfire Recovery Council.
bio.excerpt: Eagle Creek Wildfire Recovery Council; Oregon Federal Executive Board; Lake Oswego Planning Commission

positions.statement: In his voters' pamphlet statement, Guiney says the city should grow smart and sustainably while protecting neighborhoods and the environment.
positions.excerpt: Grow smart and sustainably while protecting neighborhoods and our environment.

positions.statement: Guiney's pamphlet statement says Lake Oswego should stay open for business and support vibrant commercial districts.
positions.excerpt: Keep Lake Oswego open for business and support vibrant commercial districts.

positions.statement: Guiney's pamphlet statement calls for fiscal discipline and responsible stewardship of taxpayer dollars.
positions.excerpt: Practice fiscal discipline and responsibly steward taxpayer dollars.

positions.statement: Guiney's pamphlet statement calls for investing in infrastructure and mobility to improve traffic, safety and connectivity.
positions.excerpt: Invest in infrastructure and mobility to improve traffic, safety, and connectivity.

positions.statement: Guiney's campaign site says he believes in practical leadership that delivers results.
positions.excerpt: I believe in practical leadership that delivers results.
